name: Zensar
rationale: This makes the product read as an official Zensar application rather than an ad-hoc palette.

colour_tokens.usage: Royal blue (Pantone 2728 C) — primary brand colour: key actions, links, active states (AA on white).
Navy blue (Pantone 2758 C) — button fills, hover/pressed, headers; white text (AA).
Scarlet red (Pantone 485 C) — accent / secondary highlights and active states; use dark text on fills (AA).
Sage green (Pantone 4206 C) — success badge fill; pair with dark text + icon.
Gold (Pantone 458 C) — warning badge fill; pair with dark text + icon.
Crimson red (Pantone 2350) — errors / destructive actions; white text (AA).
Black — primary text / headings on light surfaces.
Near-black neutral — body text on light surfaces (AA).
Neutral grey — secondary / muted text, captions (AA-verified).
Grey-green (from Pantone 4178 C, AA-darkened) — dividers, card & input outlines (>= 3:1 vs canvas).
